label: Comprehend: primitive relation versus knowing at a degree that reaches knowability
resolution: INCOMPREHENSIBLE_2 (IsIncomprehensibleToCausedIntellects), the bridge 'No intellect that is not INFINITE_1 comprehends an INFINITE_1 being' and the INCOMPREHENSIBLE sense bridge use COMPREHEND_1, the primitive Comprehension.Comprehends (knowing a being as perfectly as it is knowable, glossed but not typed). COMPREHEND_2 (ComprehendsByMeasure) types that gloss: knowing a being at a degree that reaches its degree of knowability, on one Preorder scale with a degree of act and a degree of knowing (definition 5b196f1c). They are not identified and neither is defined from the other. One statement relates them: the open sense bridge 'Whatever COMPREHEND_1s a being COMPREHEND_2s it', which carries that the primitive's gloss is measured on that scale. Only the argument that derives the q.12 a.7 bridge for COMPREHEND_1 from its COMPREHEND_2 version lists it in sense_bridges. The converse is not assumed: the controls of ComprehensionByMeasure have a model in which the sense bridge holds and something COMPREHEND_2s a being it does not COMPREHEND_1 (part 7), and one in which the COMPREHEND_2 version of the bridge holds and the COMPREHEND_1 version fails without the sense bridge (part 6). Neither sense is knowing simply: both are compatible with knowing a being truly without comprehending it.
